new_packages.label: חִדּוּשׁ בַּתּוֹרָה וְכֹחַ הַמְדַמֶּה
new_packages.label_en: Torah Innovation and the Imaginative Faculty
new_packages.reason: The torah's core bechina statement is explicit: innovating in Torah IS the bechina of 'medameh milta lemilta' (comparing one thing to another). This equates chiddush baTorah with the rectified use of the imaginative faculty. These are not cause-and-effect but parallel aspects of the same essential reality: the creative-comparative faculty channeled toward holiness. The koach hamedameh itself is neutral — it can generate hirhurim (evil) or Torah chiddush (good). In this package, it appears in its rectified/good orientation.

proposed_bechina_edges.reason: Explicitly stated in the text: 'שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מְדַמֶּה מִלְּתָא לְמִלְּתָא' — Torah innovation IS the bechina of comparing one thing to another.
Comparing one thing to another is the essential operation of the imaginative faculty — they share the same nature, one is the faculty, the other is its defining activity.
Torah chiddush is the rectified deployment of the koach hamedameh — in this torah they are explicitly linked as the same cognitive process directed toward holiness.

source_quotes: שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מְדַמֶּה מִלְּתָא לְמִלְּתָא, עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה מְתַקְּנִין פְּגַם הַהִרְהוּרִים שֶׁבָּאִין עַל־יְדֵי הַמְדַמֶּה
כִּי הוּא תִּקּוּן גָּדוֹל לְהִרְהוּרִים. כִּי כָל הַהִרְהוּרִים בָּאִים עַל־יְדֵי כֹּחַ הַמְדַמֶּה
new_packages.good_evil_mirror: The evil mirror of this package is the hirhurim (impure thoughts) — also generated by the koach hamedameh but in its unrectified form. The same faculty (neutral) produces either Torah chiddush (good) or hirhurim (evil).

new_packages.reason: Hirhurim (impure fantasies) are the product of the unrectified koach hamedameh. While this is a single-concept component, it represents the evil mirror of Package 1. The koach hamedameh when not channeled into Torah produces hirhurim — the same faculty, opposite orientation.
merge_notes: Single-node component. Stands as the evil mirror of Package 1. Cannot be merged into Package 1 due to opposite polarity. Does not meet the 3-node threshold for a full package on its own — documented here as the evil counterpoint.

observations: Torah #105 has zero bechina edges in the existing dataset (only 1 eitza edge: chiddush baTorah -> tikkun for hirhurim). However, the source text contains an explicit bechina statement: 'שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מְדַמֶּה מִלְּתָא לְמִלְּתָא' — directly equating Torah innovation with the act of comparing one concept to another. This anchors a proposed 3-node package around the rectified imaginative faculty. The good/evil mirror structure is clear: the koach hamedameh serves as the neutral pivot — when directed to Torah study it produces chiddush (good), when undirected it produces hirhurim (evil). The existing eitza edge correctly captures the causal relationship (chiddush CAUSES tikkun of hirhurim) and should not be reclassified. Additional benefits mentioned — tikkun he'avar (rectification of the past) and benefit for ancestors' souls — are eitza-type consequences of Torah chiddush, not bechina-type parallel aspects.
